# Smart-TV ACR IP blocklist
#
# This is the IP side of ../../DNS/acr/. Use it at the firewall (pfSense/pfBlockerNG,
# OPNsense, ipset/nftables, router ACLs) for the case DNS blocking does not cover.
#
# Why you want this as well as the DNS list. Samsung and LG sets ship with resolver
# addresses compiled into the firmware, and several models fall back to DNS-over-HTTPS
# when the resolver you handed out over DHCP refuses to answer. A TV that talks to
# 8.8.8.8 directly never sees your Pi-hole. Two things fix that, and you want both:
# redirect outbound port 53 and 853 back to your own resolver, and drop the addresses
# below at the firewall.
#
# The same warning as the Datto list applies, more so here. Most of these sit on AWS,
# Akamai and Cloudflare, they move, and they can front unrelated services. The eight
# addresses under LG Ad Solutions each serve 316 of LG's per-country ad hostnames, so
# they are worth blocking, but they are AWS load balancers and AWS reassigns those.
# The DNS lists remain the reliable block. Treat this as a backstop and re-check it.
#
# Resolved on 2026-09-17. Hostnames that did not resolve from this vantage point are
# not listed; several LG and Samsung endpoints only answer inside their own region.
#
# Total addresses: 315
#
